blocks.html: This comparison is for a small sales or service team in HubSpot that talks to customers by text and phone, and is choosing between Salesmsg and Aircall.
Both can text and both can call. The real question is which channel your team uses most, because each tool is built around one of them.

Choose Salesmsg if most conversations happen by text and you want HubSpot workflows to send messages automatically. Choose Aircall if most conversations are calls and you want a full phone system with texting on the side.
For a two-person team, Salesmsg Basic plus one extra seat is about $35 a month. Aircall needs three licenses, so its floor on Essentials is about $90 a month on annual billing.

Salesmsg Basic is $25 a month on monthly billing, with 1 seat and 1 number included, and Pro is $277 a month on monthly billing. Extra seats are $10 a month each, and extra numbers are $5 a month each. Messages and minutes use credits: 1 credit per SMS (160 characters) and 1 credit per minute of calling. There's a 14-day free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
In HubSpot, Salesmsg offers two-way contact and activity sync, texting from inside HubSpot, and SMS triggered from HubSpot workflows. It also says SMS opt-outs update the HubSpot contact property.

Aircall Essentials is $30 per license per month, billed annually, and Professional is $50 per license per month. There's a minimum of 3 licenses on Essentials and Professional, and you get 25% off for paying annually.
Aircall logs calls and SMS to HubSpot Contacts, Companies, Deals, and Tickets, with recordings, comments, outcomes, and transcription. Its Insight Cards show HubSpot history before a rep answers.

sections.label: Fit for a small HubSpot team

blocks.html: If your customers reply to texts and ignore calls, Salesmsg's workflow-triggered texts save the most time: reminders, follow-ups, and confirmations go out without a rep touching them.
If your team lives on the phone, Aircall's call logging and caller context in HubSpot matter more than texting features.
Salesmsg runs on credits, so heavy calling or long texts can cost more than the plan price suggests.
Aircall's three-license minimum makes it a poor fit for one or two people, and texting isn't the center of the product.
Pull last month's conversations and count texts against calls. Buy the tool built for the bigger number.
Whichever you choose, make sure opt-outs reach a single HubSpot property before you send any automated texts.
